summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, web developer, strong advocate for progressive taxation and social equity, critical of corporate influence in politics, engaged in discussions about climate change and environmental policy, interested in functional programming languages (Haskell, Erlang), supports labor rights and unionization, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, values education and knowledge sharing, has a nuanced understanding of economic systems and their impact on society, emphasizes the importance of community and collaboration in work environments, critical of systemic inequalities and advocates for marginalized voices.
